{{Quote|Your name is Varian Skye. You were born in Tahini and moved to Coruscant with your brother when you were 12.|Recording giving Cassian Andor his aliases backstory|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>}}
'''Tahini''' was an astronomical object<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> in the [[Tahini system]] of the [[Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was the fictional birth place of Varian Skye, an alias used by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> in [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> According to the cover story Skye and their [[gender|brother]] [[Patrio]] moved to [[Coruscant]] when Skye was twelve [[Standard year|years]] old but Patrio soon returned home to Tahini.

==Behind the scenes==
Tahini was first mentioned in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
